title: Rate-limit incoming webhooks per tenant
goal: POST /webhooks answers 429 with a Retry-After header when one tenant sends more webhooks than the configured limit in the configured window. Put the limiter in src/lib/limiter.ts, wire it into src/routes/webhooks.ts (and src/app.ts if it needs shared state), and read the limit and the window through loadConfig() in src/config.ts with defaults. Add tests in test/webhooks.test.ts or a new test file.
acceptance: A tenant over the limit gets 429 with a Retry-After header
The limit and the window come from config, not constants in a route
The suite stays green with new tests for the 429 path
